description: Save your own recipes with ingredients and steps, search them anytime.

faqs.a: Give the recipe a name, list one ingredient per line, then the steps (also one per line), and click Save Recipe.
faqs.q: How do I add a recipe?

faqs.a: The search box matches the recipe name, ingredients and steps at once.
Click a recipe card to expand its full ingredients and steps. The × button deletes it.
faqs.q: How do I view a full recipe?

faqs.a: In this browser's localStorage — private to this device, no account needed.

howto: Name your recipe and pick a category.
List ingredients and steps, one per line each.
Click a card to expand it; search to find recipes fast.
title: Recipe Box
